THE SHARED LEG IS THE FRAME-INVISIBLE ONE -- sigma_-1 = the B912/B928 wall twist D, the same element B938 showed is colorless-blind and B936 showed carries the nonzero H^1 class. The 27-shadow map is banked: sigma_-1 -> D (12 flips), sigma_chi- -> D2 (the ELEVEN), sigma_c -> D_c (12) -- K4's frame-invisible legs are 27-VISIBLE, and W_frame's carriers cast the census D-set.
